title: Salts of Cloud Giant Fingernails
summary: Alchemy extract used to make Elixir of Cloud Giant Strength.

fields.Recipe: Combine these salts with any Suspension to make Elixir of Cloud Giant Strength.
fields.Result: Sets Strength to 27 until Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 145 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
